title: TF-MoE: Time-Frequency Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Speech Separation
abstract: arXiv:2606.29575v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in speech separation (SS) have led to compact front-end models with small parameter sizes, yet their high computational cost remains a major barrier for deployment on edge devices. To address this, we propose TF-MoE, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances model capacity with almost no increase in inference cost. Our method introduces dynamic expert specialization in time and frequency dimensions through alternating time-wise and frequency-wise MoE modules, each dynamically selecting experts per frame or mel band. Built upon a mel-band-splitting Conformer backbone, TF-MoE achieves strong performance on SS tasks under low-compute settings. Experimental results demonstrate that TF-MoE consistently improves separation performance under computation cost constraints, outperforming BSRNN by +3.8 dB SDR on Libri2Mix with comparable 4.1 GMACs/s inference cost. translated_title: TF-MoE：用于高效语音分离的时频混合专家模型
translated_abstract: 语音分离（SS）领域的最新进展催生了参数规模小巧的紧凑型前端模型，但其高昂的计算成本仍然是部署到边缘设备上的主要障碍。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了TF-MoE，这是一种稀疏混合专家（MoE）框架，能够在几乎不增加推理成本的情况下增强模型容量。我们的方法通过交替使用按时间和按频率的MoE模块，在时间和频率维度上引入动态专家专门化机制，每个模块针对每帧或每个梅尔频带动态选择专家。基于梅尔频带分割的Conformer骨干网络，TF-MoE在低计算量设置下的语音分离任务中取得了优异性能。实验结果表明，TF-MoE在计算成本约束下持续提升分离性能，在Libri2Mix数据集上以相当的4.1 GMACs/s推理成本，比BSRNN高出+3.8 dB SDR。这使得TF-MoE成为一个极具前景的候选方案。
tldr: TF-MoE通过交替的时域和频域稀疏混合专家模块实现动态专家专门化，在几乎不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升语音分离性能，在Libri2Mix上以相当的计算成本比BSRNN高出3.8 dB SDR。
en_tdlr: TF-MoE introduces dynamic expert specialization through alternating time-wise and frequency-wise sparse MoE modules, significantly improving speech separation performance with almost no increase in inference cost, outperforming BSRNN by +3.8 dB SDR on Libri2Match at comparable computational cost.
